mapper.select: SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.hq_yn='N' AND (p.use_yn='Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id)) ORDER BY p.sort_seq,p.bsn_part_id
SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND p.hq_yn='N'
SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND p.hq_yn='N' FOR UPDATE

SELECT h.part_std_hist_id,h.ldr_nm,h.prft_dstrb_rt,h.bsn_fee_amt FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (h.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR h.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC,h.part_std_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.dev_id,d.dev_nm,s.emp_se_cd,s.real_pay_amt,s.slry_amt,s.rtrpay_acml_amt, (SELECT min(a.bgn_dt) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=s.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= (#{month} || '-01')::date + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day') AS first_start FROM cst.mth_cst s JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=s.dev_id WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY s.dev_id
mapper.sql: s.stlm_id,s.bsn_part_id,s.stlm_ym,s.part_std_hist_id,s.prft_dstrb_rt,s.bsn_fee_amt,s.psn_cnt, s.tot_sls_amt,s.tot_exp_amt,s.tot_diff_amt,s.tot_psn_prft_amt,s.corp_card_amt,s.part_prft_amt,s.stlm_stts_cd, (SELECT h.rsn_desc FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm='fin.part_stlm' AND h.obj_rec_id=s.stlm_id::text AND h.clmn_nm='corp_card_amt' ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS card_remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month}
SELECT FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month} FOR UPDATE OF s
SELECT f.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls f WHERE f.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT f.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls f WHERE f.cls_ym=#{month} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.dev_id,d.dev_nm,s.emp_se_cd,s.mm_qty,s.mth_untprc_amt,s.slry_amt,s.bsn_fee_amt,s.rtrpay_amt, s.tot_exp_amt,s.diff_amt,s.prft_amt,s.rmrk_desc FROM fin.part_stlm_dtl s JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=s.dev_id WHERE s.stlm_id=#{stlmId} ORDER BY s.dev_id
SELECT h.stlm_prcs_cd,h.rsn_desc,h.prcs_user_id,h.prcs_at FROM fin.part_stlm_hist h WHERE h.stlm_id=#{stlmId} ORDER BY h.prcs_at DESC,h.stlm_hist_id DESC
INSERT INTO fin.part_stlm(bsn_part_id,stlm_ym) VALUES(#{partId},#{month}) RETURNING stlm_id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET corp_card_amt=#{amount},updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stlm_id=#{stlmId} AND stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT'

UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET part_std_hist_id=#{standard.part_std_hist_id},prft_dstrb_rt=#{standard.prft_dstrb_rt}, bsn_fee_amt=#{standard.bsn_fee_amt},psn_cnt=#{people.size},tot_sls_amt=#{sales},tot_exp_amt=#{expenses}, tot_diff_amt=#{difference},tot_psn_prft_amt=#{profit},corp_card_amt=#{card},part_prft_amt=#{partProfit}, stlm_stts_cd='CONFIRM',cnfrm_user_id=#{actor},cnfrm_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bsn_part_id=#{key.partId} AND stlm_ym=#{key.month} AND stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT'

UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT',cncl_rsn_desc=#{reason},cnfrm_user_id=NULL,cnfrm_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE stlm_id=#{stlmId} AND stlm_stts_cd='CONFIRM'
